text:
Elena: heads up - found a focus clipping issue on compact action icons in the deployments table. ring gets cut off at the bottom when density token = 6px.
Mike: thanks — can you share repro? which row height and which browser?
Elena: compact rows (36px), Chrome. tab to the copy icon and half the halo is hidden.
Tara: quick glance at styles: icon button uses margin:-4px to align, and tr has overflow:hidden. that combo will clip any outside halo.
Josh: negative margins were an easy shim. long-term i'd prefer not to rely on them. options: remove overflow hidden, change alignment to padding, or swap outline for an outer box-shadow halo.
Aria: a11y priority: always-visible focus + clear label. i vote for visible outer halo and fixing container clipping. but i understand dropdowns rely on overflow hidden.
Mike: compromise: keep overflow:hidden for rows but special-case icon-only actions to render their focus halo via an absolutely-positioned pseudo-element inside the row so it won't escape. or use box-shadow on the button itself (no overflow required).
Tara: box-shadow approach example: `button.icon:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--focus-300); }` keeps it contained and is consistent across densities.
Josh: sounds reasonable. test visually for vertical rhythm impact though — adding 4px halo may make icons feel heavier in compact mode.
Elena: another problem: aria-labels for these icons are generic. screen reader reads "button copy" with no context. we should render `aria-label=\"Copy deployment id: <id>\"` or include `aria-describedby` pointing to the name cell.
Aria: prefer `aria-label` with contextual text generated server-side or at render time: `aria-label={`Copy ${deployment.name} id`}`. also for feedback use a local inline toast adjacent to the icon rather than site-wide toast.
Mike: inline toast = good UX. implement small ephemeral tooltip-style toast anchored to the icon for 1.5s with check icon. for a11y add `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` on the toast element; ensure it contains text like "Copied deployment id".
Tara: note: if we put toast inside the row we must ensure it doesn't affect layout. use absolute positioning within row and pointer-events none.
Josh: PR suggestion: change icon alignment to padding, add focus box-shadow (2px) for compact mode, add contextual aria-labels, and inline toast anchored to icon. include screenshots in PR.
Elena: QA checklist: keyboard-only traversal, mac VoiceOver, NVDA/JAWS spot-check, visual compare across compact/default/spacious densities. also regression check for dropdowns that used overflow hidden.
DesignBot: Created ticket DS-901: compact table icon focus + inline toast.
Mike: timeline? can we ship a small patch to dev this week?
Tara: can do a minimal change (box-shadow + aria-label + inline toast) and open a draft PR today. i'll include notes about not changing row overflow yet.
Josh: I'll update Figma frames with the box-shadow specs and token values.
Aria: thanks — once PR is up i'll run through screenreader flows.
Elena: thanks team. will follow up on token impact if we decide to increase row padding later.
Tara: PR draft -> #2358 (in description). pinging when ready for review. :sparkles: 
Mike: awesome, thanks.
DesignBot: Reminder: design sync tomorrow 10am.
